With the planned right-hand side the test gives 4.5×10⁻¹² relative to the product of the norms, the rounding of the flow map itself.

entries.test: Exact adjoint in the spherical shell: Self-adjoint Stokes flow
entries.value: (E = 1, r∈[0.5,1.5], T = 0.1): λ_1 = 12.071011094164 (toroidal ℓ = 1, j_1(kr_i)y_1(kr_o) = j_1(kr_o)y_1(kr_i)), confirmed as the least-damped mode by the eigenvalue solver. The discrete optimal gain exceeds e^(−2λ_1T) by 1.2×10⁻⁵, 2.5×10⁻⁶, 7.6×10⁻⁷ at N_r = 16,24,32: algebraically (≈ N^(−4.0)), while λ_1 itself is exact to 5.5×10⁻⁹ at N_r = 16 and the adjoint is exact: the first-order tau discretisation is energy-self-adjoint only to O(N⁻²), and the gain sees its square. At N_r = 128, Δt = 10⁻⁴ (RK443, 1000 steps) the gain is 0.089438663224 against e^(−2λ_1T) = 0.089438662948, 3.1×10⁻⁹ apart. A gain reported in a shell must therefore show its convergence in N_r.
